monotonic_effect <- foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_1 %>%
  spread_draws(b_Intercept, b_modefender_foul_count, simo_modefender_foul_count1[category]) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate the cumulative effect for each foul count
    effect_0 = b_Intercept,
    effect_1 = b_Intercept + b_modefender_foul_count * simo_modefender_foul_count1[1],
    effect_2 = b_Intercept + b_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2]),
    effect_3 = b_Intercept + b_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3]),
    effect_4 = b_Intercept + b_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[4]),
    effect_5 = b_Intercept + b_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[4] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[5])
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("effect_"), names_to = "foul_count", values_to = "effect") %>%
  mutate(foul_count = as.numeric(str_extract(foul_count, "\\d+"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = foul_count, y = effect)) +
  stat_lineribbon(.width = c(0.5, 0.8, 0.95), alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_brewer() +
  labs(
    title = "Monotonic Effect of Foul Count on Shot Success",
    subtitle = "Showing cumulative effect of increasing foul counts",
    x = "Defender Foul Count",
    y = "Log-Odds of Shot Success",
    fill = "Credible Interval"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
